tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Whether tenderer submitted the samples of 5Kg & 10Kg Empty container, after the tender closing but before the opening of technical bid without fail.
All terms & conditions as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Detailed technical specifications provided by the DMU duly Seal & signed by the authorized signatory.
Authorised Original Manufacturer / Authorised Dealer, If yes Valid Authorisation Certificate should be Enclosed along with bid.

Tenderer has supplied satisfactorily Goods/Material (s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity required to any other co-op milk unions under KMF / any other reputed dairy industries during last three financial year.
Client list and past work orders with satisfactorily work done Certificate.
TDS declaration form uploaded with seal and signature.
Latest Income Tax return and GSTR 3B monthly filed document.
Last 3 years financial Turn Over uploaded duly certified & signed by Chartered Accountant
